title: useCardNumberValidation | Hooks | React | Visa Product Design System

blocks.t: Learn how to utilize the useCardNumberValidation hook to validate card numbers.

The useCardNumberValidation hook validates card numbers using BIN regex patterns, length checks, the Luhn checksum algorithm (modulo 10 check), and brand identification. It's designed to be flexible, allowing for custom validators to be added as needed. Note that this validation is not exhaustive and may change over time. VPDS doesn't maintain acceptance marks for all brands due to legal reasons. This hook enables you to integrate your own validators if your use case requires them.

For comprehensive guidance on card validation, reference Card input. The useCardNumberValidation hook uses updated, type-safe validation logic that has been thoroughly unit tested. This logic can be extracted for use outside the hook, or you can bring your own validation logic as needed. While the previous Visa UI Utils library remains a viable option, it might not be supported in the future and lacks testing and type safety for TypeScript users.
